description: The document at a glance; call once, first. Decks: slides (id, title, layout, content area), size, theme colours, fonts, roles and tints, layouts and their placeholders. Documents: headings with ids, sections, styles in use, comments, revisions, fields, tables, drawings, pages. Workbooks: sheets, tables and regions with key columns, column types and fill, sample rows, flags. All: the problems it opened with.
